tech: The MK series is an \"Energize to Close\" pneumatic clamping element, it is specifically designed to stop or maintain fixed positions on profile rail guides. This patented system uses smooth-running rollers to convert the longitudinal force of the pneumatic piston into a transverse clamping force. This allows for very high holding forces without the risk of permanent jamming. The unit is an active clamping element, meaning it remains open by default and requires compressed air to activate the clamping jaws. The clamping jaws press against the \"free\" (non-functional) surfaces of the rail. This ensures that no clamping forces are transferred to the rail carriage, protecting the bearings and maintaining system precision. Features are : No Guiding Function, High Holding Force, Positioning Accuracy, High-Speed Response, Low Maintenance Design, Flexible Air Connections, Minimal Displacement. Applications : Positioning of Axes, Fixing of Vertical Axes, Positioning of Lifting Units, Clamping of Machining Tables, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Automotive Assembly, Packaging & Material Handling, Medical & Pharmaceutical. MK=Series MK of clamping elements. These are \"Normally Open\" (NO) units that are energised to close; they only apply clamping force when pneumatic pressure is provided.

The MKS series is a pneumatic clamping element. It is designed to maintain a fixed position on a linear profile rail. Normally Closed (NC) / Energize to Open. The unit uses spring-loaded energy storage to clamp the rail when air pressure is removed. This makes it a reliable safety element that maintains a fixed position during power or pressure failures. A pneumatic piston moves a patented wedge-type gear longitudinally, converting the movement into high transverse clamping force applied directly to the free surfaces of the rail. The MKS series is designed to hold a carriage in a fixed position (e.g., for heavy machining or fixing vertical axes) and is not suitable for active braking of moving loads. Features are : Non-Guiding Design, Maintenance-Free, PLUS Air Connection, Zero-Load Clamping, Self-Centering Action, Environmental Resilience, Precision and Speed, Safety Clamping, High Cycle Life. Applications : Emergency Stops, Fixing Vertical Axes, Table Retention, Positioning Axes, CNC Machining Centers, Automated Assembly Lines, Medical & Lab Automation, Packaging Machinery, Material Handling. MKS: This is a \"Normally Closed\" (NC) series, meaning the default state is Locked. It uses internal springs to clamp and needs air pressure to \"open.\"

The HK series is a manual clamping element, specifically engineered for static holding on profile rail guides like the Rollon. It is a \"bi-stable\" unit, meaning it remains in its current state (clamped or unclamped) until manually changed by the operator. It utilizes floating clamping jaws that press synchronously against the free surfaces of the rail. This symmetrical application of force prevents the rail from being pushed to one side, maintaining system alignment. This element is engineered strictly for static clamping. It must not be used for dynamic braking (stopping a moving load), as this will cause significant wear and potential damage to both the element and the linear rail. Features are : Freely Adjustable Lever, Symmetrical Force Distribution, Maintenance-Free Design, High Holding Force, Positioning Accuracy, No Guiding Properties, High Rigidity & Zero Impact. Applications : Table Traverses and Carriages, Optical Instruments and Measuring Tables, Adjustment of Width and Stops, Manufacturing & CNC, Medical Technology, Robotics & Automation, Transportation & Logistics.
